summary: Get a variable of the first host in a group with hostvars[groups['webservers'][0]], optionally via set_fact; with dynamic inventory the first host may not be stable.
questions: How do I get the IP of the first web server?
Is groups['x'][0] always the same host?
How do I store the head node name in a variable?

answer_card.title: Use a variable from the first host in a group
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- set_fact:
    headnode: "{{ groups['webservers'][0] }}"
- debug:
    msg: "{{ hostvars[headnode].ansible_eth0.ipv4.address }}"
```

With dynamic inventory the order (and so the "first" host) may change; only rely on it with stable inventory.
